articles.headline: Nakashima replaces US Open runner-up Shelton for Laver Cup
articles.description: US Open runner-up Ben Shelton withdrew from the Laver Cup and will be replaced by 16th-ranked Brandon Nakashima on Team World, organizers announced Thursday.

images.alt: Nakashima replaces US Open runner-up Shelton for Laver Cup

articles.headline: WTA Finals head to Charlotte in 2027 to start 3-year run
articles.description: The WTA Finals are moving to Charlotte, North Carolina, starting in 2027, with the tour's headquarters also relocating there from St. Petersburg, Florida.

articles.headline: US Open men's final draws record audience of 3.2 million
articles.description: The US Open men's final between champion Alexander Zverev and American Ben Shelton averaged 3.2 million viewers on ABC, the largest viewership for that match since ESPN's family of networks began televising the tournament in 2009.
